title: Fix correct answer option text color and bold styling in quiz screen

requirements.summary: Fix the correct answer option text to be clearly visible with high-contrast dark color (deep teal or dark green) and bold font-weight when highlighted after the user clicks an answer in QuizScreen.tsx and ReviewScreen.tsx
acceptanceCriteria: After clicking an option in the quiz, the correct answer option displays its text in a clearly visible, high-contrast color against the highlighted background (teal/green).
The correct answer option text is rendered in bold (font-weight: bold or font-bold Tailwind class).
The fix is applied in both QuizScreen.tsx and ReviewScreen.tsx for all correct-answer highlighted states.
Incorrect options and unselected options retain their existing text color and weight.
No other UI element styling is changed.

file_operations.description: Update the option rendering logic to apply dark, high-contrast text color (e.g., text-teal-900 or text-green-900) and bold font-weight (font-bold) to the correct answer option when it is highlighted after the user has submitted their answer. Ensure the text color contrasts clearly against the teal/green background highlight. Do not modify background or border colors of the correct answer highlight.

Update the option rendering logic to apply dark, high-contrast text color (e.g., text-teal-900 or text-green-900) and bold font-weight (font-bold) to the correct answer option when it is highlighted during review. Ensure the text color contrasts clearly against the teal/green background highlight. Do not modify background or border colors of the correct answer highlight.
